verdict.rationale: An independent probe confirms a live llms.txt at cactuscompute.com (HTTP 200). The docs also include a set of agent-oriented /llms/* pages (api, pricing, run-locally), written as instructions to an agent, and they explicitly list 'a coding agent with your API key' as a supported way to run the platform. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on report of an agent actually being pointed at these docs and succeeding.
